meaning_en: An option the user can select.
meaning_zh: 用户可以选择的一个选项。

meaning_en: The option currently chosen by the user.
An action, such as a button tap, that starts a set of instructions.
meaning_zh: 例如点击按钮，会触发一组指令。

meaning_en: A comparison that gives TRUE or FALSE.
meaning_zh: 一个会得到 TRUE 或 FALSE 结果的比较。

meaning_en: Instructions followed when the condition is TRUE.
meaning_zh: 条件为 TRUE 时执行的指令。

meaning_en: Instructions followed when the condition is FALSE.
meaning_zh: 条件为 FALSE 时执行的指令。

meaning_en: What the app displays after following its instructions.
meaning_zh: 应用程序执行指令后显示的结果。

meaning_en: An app part such as a Label, Button or Spinner.
meaning_zh: 应用的一个部分，例如 Label、Button 或 Spinner。

meaning_en: A setting of a component, such as Text or Picture.
meaning_zh: 组件的设置，例如 Text 或 Picture。

meaning_en: A property controlling the words a component displays.
meaning_zh: 控制组件显示哪些文字的属性。

meaning_en: Where you change the app layout and component properties.
meaning_zh: 修改应用外观与组件属性的地方。

meaning_en: Where you read and change the app instructions.
meaning_zh: 阅读与修改应用指令的地方。

meaning_en: The app used to run and try the project on a supported device.
meaning_zh: 在支持的设备上运行和试用项目所用的应用。

meaning_en: The editable app project that you can import into MIT App Inventor.
meaning_zh: 可以导入 MIT App Inventor 并继续编辑的项目文件。
